handwritten.title: Printed & Handwritten
handwritten.body: Extracts text from typed documents, handwritten notes, printed receipts, screenshots, and mixed-media images.

confidence.title: Confidence Scoring
confidence.body: Each extraction is rated as high, medium, or low confidence so you know where to double-check the output.

reuse.title: One-Click Copy & Reuse
reuse.body: Extracted text is immediately editable and can be piped into the Plagiarism Checker, Grammar Checker, or Summarizer.

items.notes: Digitising handwritten lecture notes or meeting whiteboard photos
items.screenshots: Extracting text from screenshots of articles or social posts
items.receipts: Converting scanned receipts or invoices into editable data
items.archive: Archiving physical documents into searchable text
items.research: Extracting quotes or data from printed research papers

items.lighting: Ensure good lighting and a straight-on angle — blurry or skewed photos reduce accuracy significantly.
items.handwriting: For handwritten text, write clearly and avoid overlapping letters for the best extraction.
items.resolution: High-resolution images (1MP+) produce noticeably better results than compressed photos.
items.grammar: After extraction, run through the Grammar Checker to catch any OCR errors.

formats.question: Which image formats are supported?
formats.answer: PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF, up to 8MB per image. If your file is larger, resize or compress it before uploading.

handwriting.question: Can it read handwriting?
handwriting.answer: It can, but accuracy depends heavily on legibility. Clear, printed handwriting works reasonably well; messy cursive often produces errors, so proofread the result.

how.question: How does the OCR work?
how.answer: Your image is sent to a vision AI model (Google's Gemini) that reads the text in it, which handles photos, screenshots, and scans better than traditional pattern-matching OCR.

cost.question: How much does an extraction cost?
cost.answer: 1 image token per image, regardless of how much text it contains. Failed extractions are refunded automatically.

storage.question: Is my image stored?
storage.answer: The image is sent over HTTPS for processing and is not published or shared. Only a short text preview of the run is kept in your private history, which you can delete anytime.
